sentences.en: The two friends have formed a deep bond of friendship.
sentences.zh: 这两个朋友之间建立了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: If it weren't for our friendship I would be miserable.
sentences.zh: 如果没有我们的友情，我会很不开心。

sentences.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
sentences.zh: 我们之间的亲密友谊使我们彼此紧密相连。
